research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Europe-led kidswear trade fairs; premium and mid-market childrenswear, newborn to teen
title: SS27 Kids' Design and Production Innovations
summary: Storytelling-led design, artist collaborations, durable construction and product data ready for the EU Digital Product Passport.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Collections designed as worlds and characters (Playtime Paris)<sup>[1]</sup>; Bobo Choses and Halcyon Nights build collections around books and artist panels<sup>[2]</sup>.
- Durability and functionality over short-lived seasonality<sup>[3]</sup>.
- The EU textiles Digital Product Passport delegated act is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027; since 19 July 2026, large companies may not destroy certain unsold apparel<sup>[4]</sup>.

design_implications:
- Record fibre, origin, care and safety test results for every style.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Plan rework, resale or donation routes for unsold stock in the EU.
